name: Impirical Evidence
summary:
A comedy adventure game featuring classic inventory based puzzles. Arthur is a skeptic who dedicated his life to denying the paranormal. Murray is the electric Imp he accidentally summoned. Now Arthur must solve mysteries while bound to the very evidence of the supernatural itself.

Arthur Marley is a professional Paranormal Debunker.

For twenty years he has used science, deductive logic, and a healthy dose of arrogance to prove that every ghost is just a projection and every monster is just a well-made costume. He is a man of facts in a world of frauds.

He was the best at denying the impossible… until he accidentally summoned it.

Enter Murray.

A chaotic, playful, electric Imp. He is bound to Arthur and subject to physics laws, yet he cannot directly interact with it and remains invisible to everyone else.

Now Arthur must continue his investigations while dragging around a supernatural partner he refuses to believe in.

Impirical Evidence is a comedy adventure that blends the inventory-based gameplay of 90s classics with a modern, gamepad-friendly presentation.
